map.提示：1汤勺约15ml。比例为通用基础配方，实际可根据口味微调。糖醋菜可加少许盐: Tip: 1 soup spoon ≈15ml. Ratios are general base recipes; adjust by taste in practice. Sweet-and-sour dishes can add a little salt for umami; fish-fragrant dishes need minced pickled chili prepared separately.
map.凉拌菜按总量反推盐、醋、油、辣的用量，尤其多人份或外卖标准化出品时减少误差。: For cold dishes reverse-derive salt, vinegar, oil, chili amounts by total; especially for multi-portion or takeout standardized output to reduce error.

map.比例是按体积还是重量？: Is the ratio by volume or weight?
map.家常液体调料多按体积（勺/毫升）近似，固体（糖、盐）按重量更准；本工具以体积比例: Home liquid seasonings are mostly approximated by volume (spoon / ml), solids (sugar, salt) more accurate by weight; this tool mainly converts by volume ratio, adjustable by your available measure.
map.鱼香汁在糖醋基础上加泡椒/豆瓣酱、姜葱蒜成咸甜酸辣复合味；糖醋汁偏纯酸甜，比例与: Fish-fragrant sauce adds pickled chili / bean paste, ginger scallion garlic on the sweet-sour base into a salty-sweet-sour-spicy compound taste; sweet-and-sour is pure sweet-sour, with different ratio and flavoring focus.
map.为什么同比例有时偏咸？: Why sometimes salty with same ratio?
map.不同品牌酱油盐度、醋的酸度差异大，按比例调好后务必尝味微调，工具比例作起点而非绝: Different brands of soy saltiness and vinegar acidity vary greatly; after mixing by ratio always taste and fine-tune; tool ratio is a starting point, not an absolute standard.

map.各调料用量 = 基准勺数 × 该调料比例系数；本页实际预设：糖醋汁 糖:醋:酱油: Each seasoning amount = base spoon count × that seasoning ratio coefficient; actual presets on this page: sweet-and-sour sugar:vinegar:soy sauce:cooking wine:water = 3:3:1:1:2, fish-fragrant soy sauce:vinegar:sugar:cooking wine:water = 2:2:2:1:2, kung-pao soy sauce:vinegar:sugar:cooking wine:water = 2:2:2:1:1; see the ratio table for other profiles; total amount = base spoon count × sum of coefficients. Ratios are general base recipes for reference only and can be adjusted to taste; when scaling up keep coefficients unchanged to reproduce the flavor consistently.
map.调糖醋汁、照烧汁时按固定比例（如糖:醋:酱油:料酒:水 = 3:3:1:1:2）: For sweet-and-sour sauce or teriyaki, convert in batches by a fixed ratio (e.g. sugar:vinegar:soy sauce:cooking wine:water = 3:3:1:1:2), keeping taste consistent and avoiding guesswork.
map.通用糖醋汁 糖:醋:酱油:料酒:水 = 3:3:1:1:2（可按口味加少许淀粉勾: Common sweet-and-sour sauce sugar:vinegar:soy sauce:cooking wine:water = 3:3:1:1:2 (optional a little starch to thicken); for 200 ml total, divide by coefficient sum 10: about 60 ml sugar, 60 ml vinegar, 20 ml soy sauce, 20 ml cooking wine, 40 ml water, then adjust sweet/sour to taste.
